HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE
  CITY OF LONG BEACH, CALIFORNIA AGENDA
  TUESDAY, AUGUST 12, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 4:30 PM

Mary Zendejas, 1st District  Dr. Suely Saro, 6th District
Cindy Allen, 2nd District  Roberto Uranga, 7th District
Kristina Duggan, 3rd District  Tunua Thrash-Ntuk, 8th District, Chair
Daryl Supernaw, 4th District  Dr. Joni Ricks-Oddie, 9th District, Vice Chair
Megan Kerr, 5th District  Anthony Taranto, Tenant Commissioner

Thomas B. Modica, Executive Director  Dawn McIntosh, City Attorney
Alison King, Assistant Executive Director

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  25-56088  Recommendation to approve minutes for the Housing Authority of the City of Long
  Beach, California meeting of Tuesday, June 10, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  25-56089  Recommendation to authorize Housing Authority Executive Director, or designee,
  to execute all documents necessary to amend Contract No. 36280 with BDO USA,
  LLP a Delaware limited liability partnership, of Philadelphia, PA, for providing
  accounting services for the City of Long Beach Housing Authority, to increase the
  contract amount by $400,000, for a revised contract amount not to exceed
  $1,000,000. (Citywide)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  25-56090  Recommendation to adopt resolution authorizing City Manager, or designee, to
  execute all required documents necessary to accept funding in the amount not to
  exceed $993,482, from the County of Los Angeles, to continue to administer the
  Homeless Incentive Program (HIP) for the period of July 1, 2025, through June 30,
  2026. (Citywide)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.
